title: Lifting a prescribed Stonean hypercover over one affine base
statement: Let $T$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] with w-strictly local coordinate ring [sk-def-pe-wlocal], let $P$ be a profinite space in the same universe [def-weil-size-convention], and let $a:P\simeq\pi_0(T)$ be a homeomorphism. Let $S_\bullet$ be a simplicial profinite space over $P$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] with surjective proper-face matching arrows, zero matching object $P$, extremally disconnected terms and surjective augmentations [def-sfb-proper-face-diagram]. Then there exist a simplicial object $U_\bullet$ in the full small pro-etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and natural continuous coordinates $p_n:|U_n|\to S_n$ with the following properties. Every proper-face matching arrow is a singleton pro-etale covering, and the zero matching object is exactly $\operatorname{id}_T$. Every term is affine, its coordinate ring is w-contractible, and it is weakly contractible for sheaves of sets in universe $u+1$ [sk-def-pe-weak-contractible]. Every structure map is stalkwise an isomorphism; $|U_n|$ is homeomorphic to $\{(x,s)\mid\pi_0(x)=a(t_n(s))\}$ over both coordinates, and $p_n$ identifies both the component space and the closed-point space with $S_n$. For $C=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ and $f_n:S_n\to\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec} C)$ induced by $a,t_n$ and $T\simeq\operatorname{Spec} C$, the term $U_n$ is isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec} D_n$ over $T$, where $D_n$ is the colimit of the finite clopen-partition restriction diagram [def-sfb-stonean-partition-diagram]. There is a $C$-algebra equivalence from $D_n$ to the canonical graph-restriction ring, sending the stage element $(r_b)_b$ to the image of the corresponding locally constant function under the algebra map. Under this equivalence and scheme isomorphism the canonical profinite projection is $p_n$. The empty case is included.

proof.text: Let $T$ be the given affine scheme and transport the base $P$ to $\pi_0(T)$ along $a$. Apply the relative component functor to the prescribed simplicial profinite object. Functoriality supplies every operator. Finite-limit preservation transports each proper-face limiting cone; identify the zero vertex with the terminal object over $T$, changing its cone by that canonical isomorphism. Cover preservation sends each surjective matching arrow to a singleton pro-etale covering. The relative pullback-space theorem gives affine terms, stalk isomorphisms, the underlying spaces $|T|\times_P S_n$, natural second coordinates and the component homeomorphisms. These are objects of the full small pro-etale site.

source.place: Lemma 2.2.8 and its more precise statement; HRS paragraph before equation (4.1)

proof.text: For each degree, apply the Stonean component-cover theorem to $C=\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$, $S_n$, and the composite $S_n\to P\xrightarrow a\pi_0(T)\to\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec} C)$. The map is surjective by the assumed augmentation surjectivity and the two homeomorphisms. The theorem gives a normalized $C$-algebra equivalence from the partition colimit $D_n$ to the canonical graph-restriction ring, with w-contractibility, stalkwise isomorphisms and the homeomorphism of closed points to $S_n$.

source.place: Preliminaries and assertions 1–4; Stacks Tag 097D, proetale.tex label lemma-construct-profinite

proof.text: For a partition $\mathcal Q$, the canonical restriction theorem and the finite-product spectrum theorem give a homeomorphism $|\operatorname{Spec}(\prod_{A\in\mathcal Q}C_{t_n(A)})|\simeq\coprod_{A\in\mathcal Q}\pi_T^{-1}(t_n(A))$. Under refinement its map is $(x,A')\mapsto(x,A)$ for the containing part $A$. The partition-restriction theorem supplies the small nonempty directed diagram and precisely these restriction maps. Its colimit is the displayed $D_n$. The filtered-spectrum topological-limit theorem and the profinite partition-incidence-limit theorem therefore identify $|\operatorname{Spec}D_n|$ homeomorphically with $|T|\times_P S_n$, compatibly with the two projections. This uses the topology conclusions of those nodes, not just their point bijections.

source.place: Assertion 2, the partition diagram and the topology of its inverse limit; compare Stacks Tag 097D

proof.text: Both the relative lift $T\times_P S_n\to T$ and the ring model $\operatorname{Spec}D_n\to T$ have isomorphisms on all stalks by steps 4–5. Their topological homeomorphism from step 6 is over $|T|$. Apply the stalk-isomorphism lifting theorem to this homeomorphism, and then to its inverse, with these two structure morphisms as targets. It gives mutually inverse scheme morphisms over $T$: their composites have underlying identity maps, and the uniqueness clause identifies them with the identity morphisms. This is the canonical isomorphism over $T$ and $S_n$. Thus the actual relative lift has the stated ring model and its coordinate ring is w-contractible. Since it is an object of $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the affine w-contractible projectivity theorem shows that every sheaf epimorphism evaluates there surjectively. Transport the closed-point homeomorphism through this scheme isomorphism. The isomorphism of the coordinate rings with the graph ring transports w-contractibility; the projectivity theorem gives weak contractibility of each site object. The finite-stage normalization is exactly that of the Stonean component-cover theorem. For empty $S_n$, the empty partition gives the zero ring and all claims remain valid.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_common_component_hypercover_single_lift
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine T] [IsWStrictlyLocalRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
    {P : Profinite.{u}} (a : P ≃ₜ ConnectedComponents T)
    (S : SimplicialObject (Over P))
    (hS :
      ∃ (M : ∀ n : ℕ, Cone (S.properFaceDiagram n))
        (μ : ∀ n : ℕ, S _⦋n⦌ ⟶ (M n).pt),
        (M 0).pt = Over.mk (𝟙 P) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (IsLimit (M n))) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (b : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory n),
          μ n ≫ (M n).π.app (op b) = S.map b.obj.hom.op) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, Function.Surjective (μ n).left) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, ExtremallyDisconnected (S _⦋n⦌).left) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, Function.Surjective (S _⦋n⦌).hom)) :
    ∃ (U : SimplicialObject T.ProEt)
      (p : ∀ n : ℕ, C((U _⦋n⦌).left, (S _⦋n⦌).left)),
      (∃ (M : ∀ n : ℕ, Cone (U.properFaceDiagram n))
          (μ : ∀ n : ℕ, U _⦋n⦌ ⟶ (M n).pt),
        (M 0).pt = Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (IsLimit (M n))) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (b : SimplicialObject.ProperFaceCategory n),
          μ n ≫ (M n).π.app (op b) = U.map b.obj.hom.op) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, Presieve.singleton (μ n) ∈ Scheme.ProEt.precoverage T (M n).pt)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, IsAffine (U _⦋n⦌).left ∧
        IsWContractibleRing Γ((U _⦋n⦌).left, ⊤) ∧
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology T).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} (U _⦋n⦌)) ∧
      (∀ (m n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) (f : m ⟶ n) (x : (U.obj m).left),
        p n.unop.len ((U.map f).left x) = (S.map f).left (p m.unop.len x)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, (∀ x : (U _⦋n⦌).left, IsIso ((U _⦋n⦌).hom.stalkMap x)) ∧
        (∃ H : (U _⦋n⦌).left ≃ₜ
            {z : T × (S _⦋n⦌).left | ConnectedComponents.mk z.1 = a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom z.2)},
          (∀ x, (H x).val.1 = (U _⦋n⦌).hom x) ∧ (∀ x, (H x).val.2 = p n x)) ∧
        (∃ c : ConnectedComponents (U _⦋n⦌).left ≃ₜ (S _⦋n⦌).left,
          ∀ x : (U _⦋n⦌).left, c (ConnectedComponents.mk x) = p n x) ∧
        (∃ c : closedPoints (U _⦋n⦌).left ≃ₜ (S _⦋n⦌).left,
          ∀ x : closedPoints (U _⦋n⦌).left, c x = p n x.val)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        ∃ (e : (colimit (Algebra.stoneanPartitionDiagram Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
              (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩)) :
            CommAlgCat Γ(T, ⊤)) ≃ₐ[Γ(T, ⊤)]
            WContractification.PullbackProfinite Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
              (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩))
          (k : (U _⦋n⦌).left ≅ Spec (.of
            (colimit (Algebra.stoneanPartitionDiagram Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
              (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩)) : CommAlgCat Γ(T, ⊤)))),
          (∀ (Q : DiscreteQuotient (S _⦋n⦌).left) (r : Q → Γ(T, ⊤)),
            e ((colimit.ι (Algebra.stoneanPartitionDiagram Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
                (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩)) (op Q)).hom
                  (fun b ↦ algebraMap Γ(T, ⊤) _ (r b))) =
              algebraMap (LocallyConstant (S _⦋n⦌).left Γ(T, ⊤))
                (WContractification.PullbackProfinite Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
                  (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩))
                (LocallyConstant.comapₐ Γ(T, ⊤) ⟨Q.proj, Q.proj_continuous⟩
                  ⟨r, IsLocallyConstant.of_discrete r⟩)) ∧
          k.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(T, ⊤)
              (colimit (Algebra.stoneanPartitionDiagram Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
                (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩)) : CommAlgCat Γ(T, ⊤)))) ≫
              T.isoSpec.inv = (U _⦋n⦌).hom ∧
          (∀ x : (U _⦋n⦌).left,
            WContractification.PullbackProfinite.projT Γ(T, ⊤) (S _⦋n⦌).left
              (⟨fun s ↦ T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap
                (a ((S _⦋n⦌).hom s)),
              T.isoSpec.hom.continuous.connectedComponentsMap_continuous.comp
                (a.continuous.comp (S _⦋n⦌).hom.hom.hom.continuous)⟩)
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.symm.toRingHom) (k.hom x)) = p n x))
